headline: The biggest risk in this program is Vendor data feed contracts (Ops). It's blocked, it's on the critical path, and 15 tasks across 5 teams can't start until it's done.

risks.why_it_matters: The ingestion pipeline and data validation can't start until this contract is signed, and a lot of the program sits behind those. There's no spare time here, so every day it stays blocked pushes the launch back a day.
risks.mitigation: Ask legal to fast-track the contract review this week. In parallel, have Ops line up a backup data source so Engineering isn't waiting on one vendor.

risks.why_it_matters: It's 40% done and four other pieces of work are waiting on it: audit logging, the dashboard front-end, analytics tagging and the security pen test.
risks.mitigation: Move one engineer from the accessibility review (T29), which isn't urgent yet, onto the reporting API for the next week.

risks.why_it_matters: This is already done. It's on the list because everything else builds on it, so a gap found here late would mean the most rework.
risks.mitigation: Nothing to do now. If a new requirement comes up, handle it as a change request rather than reopening T01.
